data.name: Qirat
data.gender_notes: Qirat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Qirat is a beautiful Islamic name derived from the Arabic word 'Qirā’ah', meaning 'recitation'. It refers to the beautiful, rhythmic recitation of the Quran. It represents a soul connected to divine words and spiritual reflection. The name Qirat carries the meaning “Recitation of the Quran” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Qirat usually hope their child will grow to embody recitation of the quran and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes closeness to God through the words of the Quran and the purity of one’s voice and faith.
data.etymology: Qirat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Recitation of the Quran.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qirat total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: قراة

in_urdu.name: قرأت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام قرأت عربی زبان کے الفاظ 'قرأ' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں قرآن کی تلاوت کرنا یا پڑھنا، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ قرآن مجید کی تلاوت اور مطالعے کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.name: किरात

in_pashto.name: قراة
